name: run_subagent
description: Hand a self-contained side task to a helper agent with a fresh, empty conversation (e.g. 'review these 3 files against rule X', 'find every caller of Y and summarize'). It has Orwick's read-only tools (files, grep, skills, Jira) unless allow_changes is true; writes and commands still ask the user. Only its final report comes back, so its file reads don't fill your conversation. Give it everything it needs in task: it can't see this conversation.

task.description: The whole task: goal, files or names to look at, and what to report back

allow_changes.description: Also give it the tools that change files or run commands (each still asks the user). Default false
